description:
## Outcome

Confirm the target-specific Mix release as the one isolated package method for the first target matrix. Use Burrito only if a required target test fails and the Mix release configuration or launcher cannot correct it.

## Evidence already available

A macOS ARM64 feasibility test on 2026-08-13 used the production build and the paint-first CLI entry order.

- Help and version improved from 0.83-0.85 seconds in the escript to 0.22-0.23 seconds in the release.
- The first TUI frame improved from 0.88-0.99 seconds to 0.25-0.28 seconds.
- Runtime ready improved from 3.41-3.55 seconds to 0.86-0.96 seconds.
- The escript was 71 MB. The release was 217 MB after extraction and 76 MB as a gzip archive.
- A normal `mix release` is blocked because `llm_db` is a regular application of Jidoka and an included application of ReqLLM.
- A disposable metadata correction proved feasibility. It is not an acceptable release build fix.

## Work

1. Resolve the `llm_db` application ownership conflict in source dependency metadata or release configuration. Do not rewrite a built dependency.
2. Add a supported release entry module and launcher that enter the CLI before application startup.
3. Build a production Mix release without a post-build metadata patch.
4. Run focused startup, terminal cleanup, runtime-data, exit-status, foreground-daemon, and native-dependency checks on macOS ARM64.
5. Repeat the required checks on macOS x86-64, Linux x86-64, and Windows x86-64 on native runners.
6. Record warm and cold startup measurements, extracted size, archive size, native dependencies, and all failed gates.
7. Select Burrito only if a required gate cannot be met with the Mix release. Record the reason and remove the rejected path.
8. Write one decision record with a reversal rule for a later target failure.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A normal source build creates the release with no dependency metadata rewrite.
- [ ] Evidence exists for all four first targets.
- [ ] Required terminal, runtime-data, CLI, daemon, and exit checks pass.
- [ ] Warm medians meet the release-plan limits.
- [ ] Native dependency behavior is known for each target.
- [ ] The installed-size cost and compressed-size cost are recorded and accepted.
- [ ] Only one packaging system remains maintained.
- [ ] The decision record states how to reverse the choice if a later target fails.

## Tests

Use native-runner feasibility artifacts and focused package checks. Keep live providers disabled. The full shared harness remains a later draft-release gate.

## Non-goals

Do not close this task from the temporary macOS build alone. Do not publish a release, add signing, or maintain two package builders.

comments.text:
Startup and package evidence from 2026-08-13:

- Production escript help/version: 0.83-0.85 s.
- OTP release help/version: 0.22-0.23 s.
- Production escript first TUI frame: 0.88-0.99 s.
- OTP release first TUI frame: 0.25-0.28 s.
- Production escript runtime ready: 3.41-3.55 s.
- OTP release runtime ready: 0.86-0.96 s.
- Escript size: 71 MB.
- Release size: 217 MB extracted and 76 MB gzip.
- Stock Mix release blocker: llm_db is both a regular Jidoka application and an included ReqLLM application.
- The successful release used a disposable metadata correction. It proves feasibility only.

Decision: use the Mix release as the preferred path. Keep this task open until the source-level blocker is fixed and all four native targets pass. Burrito is only a fallback.

title: Confirm Mix release packaging on the first target matrix
